mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_DRIVE_ITEM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_DRIVE( DRIVE_ITEM_ID, PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, FRST_RGTR_ID, ITEM_TYPE_CD, BOOKMARK_YN, ITEM_NM, FRST_REG_DT, DEL_YN, DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID, DRIVE_SCOPE_CD, PROJ_ID ) VALUES( #{driveItemId}, #{prntDriveItemId}, #{frstRgtrId}, #{itemTypeCd}, 'N', #{itemNm}, SYSDATE, 'N', #{driveAtchFileId}, #{driveScopeCd}, #{projId} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, A.* FROM ( SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.FRST_RGTR_ID, D.LAST_MDFR_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.BOOKMARK_YN, D.ITEM_NM, D.FRST_REG_DT, D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, D.DRIVE_SCOPE_CD, D.PROJ_ID, D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID, DTL.FILE_SZ, DTL.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM TB_DRIVE D LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL DTL ON D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID = DTL.ATCH_FILE_DTL_ID WHERE D.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{empId} AND D.DRIVE_SCOPE_CD = '01' AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (#{prntDriveItemId} IS NULL AND D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID IS NULL) OR D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{prntDriveItemId} ) ORDER BY D.ITEM_TYPE_CD ASC, D.FRST_REG_DT ASC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE RN > #{offset}

SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.FRST_RGTR_ID, D.LAST_MDFR_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.BOOKMARK_YN, D.ITEM_NM, D.FRST_REG_DT, D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, D.DRIVE_SCOPE_CD, D.PROJ_ID, D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID, DTL.FILE_SZ, DTL.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM TB_DRIVE D LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL DTL ON D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID = DTL.ATCH_FILE_DTL_ID WHERE D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} AND D.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DRIVE SET DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_DT = SYSDATE, DELTR_MBR_ID = #{deltrMbrId} WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT DRIVE_ITEM_ID FROM TB_DRIVE START WITH DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR DRIVE_ITEM_ID = PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID ) AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID FROM TB_DRIVE D WHERE D.DEL_YN = 'N' START WITH D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID

SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.FRST_RGTR_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.ITEM_NM, D.DEL_DT, D.DELTR_MBR_ID, D.FRST_REG_DT, D.DRIVE_SCOPE_CD, D.PROJ_ID, DTL.FILE_SZ, DTL.ORGNL_FILE_NM, E1.EMP_NM AS deltrMbrNm, E2.EMP_NM AS frstRgtrNm, E3.EMP_NM AS lastMdfrNm, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DRIVE C WHERE C.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID = D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID AND C.DEL_YN = 'Y' ) AS CHILD_CNT FROM TB_DRIVE D LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL DTL ON D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID = DTL.ATCH_FILE_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E1 ON D.DELTR_MBR_ID = E1.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E2 ON D.FRST_RGTR_ID = E2.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E3 ON D.LAST_MDFR_ID = E3.EMP_ID WHERE D.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{empId} AND D.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND ( D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_DRIVE P WHERE P.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID AND P.DEL_YN = 'Y' ) ) ORDER BY D.DEL_DT DESC

SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID FROM TB_DRIVE D WHERE D.DEL_YN = 'Y' START WITH D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DRIVE SET DEL_YN = 'N', DEL_DT = NULL, DELTR_MBR_ID = NULL WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT DRIVE_ITEM_ID FROM TB_DRIVE START WITH DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR DRIVE_ITEM_ID = PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID ) AND DEL_YN = 'Y'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_DRIVE WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT DRIVE_ITEM_ID FROM TB_DRIVE START WITH DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR DRIVE_ITEM_ID = PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID ) AND DEL_YN = 'Y'
